acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira talks with a radio announcer in Truckee, California, about the increasingly alarming content of his fishing reports.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Producer Alix Spiegel reports on the city of Pacifica, California. A huge fight erupted there after it was asked to start planning for sea level rise. Some in town think it’s time to face the future, others say it’s far too early.
acts.title: Apocalypse Now-ish

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Miami writer Mario Alejandro Ariza on how his city is trying to beat back the impacts of climate change. He says it’s going about as well as the playground brawls he endured as a kid.
acts.credits: By Mario Alejandro Ariza and Laura Starecheski
acts.title: Resilience is Futile
